reason: This case's first captures were generated before the two predeclared configurations and the capture harness were committed to this repository's git history (agent_harness.py was committed in 7b9d99b; this capture's own capture_ingested_at_utc predates it). Content equality with the currently-committed protocol was independently verified (see the archived agent-run.json's benchmark_protocol_commit), but the coordinating reviewer's requirement is precommitment, not merely content equality: the protocol must be committed strictly before generation, not only provably identical to it after the fact. Withdrawn and replaced with a fresh capture generated after the protocol-freeze commit that added benchmarks/agent_quality/protocol_registry.json.

discovered_by.method: Chronology audit comparing each capture's capture_ingested_at_utc against the git committer date of the commit that first established or corrected its prompt-package content.
